common.harmonics: k = 0..18 of numpy rfft over the 36 samples; s(psi) = sum_k w_k Re(c_k exp(i k (psi + pi))), w = [1, 2..2, 1] / 36
common.filter: F2 replay (m8_replay.py, unchanged); h and Jacobian replaced through h_ref.SwapS; mean correction mu_s = 0

SWB-O.block: SWB_O_COEFS.csv (25 LoS stations, raw station curves)
SWB-O.interpolation: Delaunay-linear in (x, y), nearest station outside the hull; d/dx, d/dy central difference 1 mm

SWB-C.space: Corridor block used in the Office
SWB-C.interpolation: cubic spline in x per y-line, linear in y (corridor coordinates)
SWB-C.mapping: Office (x, y, psi) -> Corridor (10 + s*rho, 0, psi); rho = |(x, y) - (5, 2.2)|, s = sign(x - 5); chain-rule Jacobian

SWB-C0.space: Corridor block used in the Office
